question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**jeopardise**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights the negative effects of climate change on agriculture.
 
• The blank describes how rising temperatures and unpredictable weather impact crops and food security.
 
• "**Jeopardise**" means to put something at risk or in danger, which fits the context perfectly.
 
• Other options like "**enhance**", "**promote**", and "**stabilise**" have positive meanings and do not match the negative context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Enhance** (सुधारना): means to improve or increase — opposite in meaning to the context.
 
• **Promote **(बढ़ावा देना): means to encourage or advance — does not fit the negative tone.
 
• **Stabilise** (स्थिर करना): means to make steady or firm — does not imply danger or harm.
 
• **Jeopardise** (जोखिम में डालना): fits best as it means to endanger or threaten something.
